palettes.name: Kora River Ostinato
leads: kora melody played on its upper strings
supports: ngoni ostinato interlocking with the melody
calabash and light shaker keeping the twelve-beat cycle
palettes.bass: warm acoustic bass doubling the lowest ostinato notes

harmony.simple: Center on one home chord with a single contrasting chord at the end of each cycle.
harmony.layered: Alternate the home chord with its neighbor a step above, letting the ostinato's top notes outline each change.
harmony.intricate: Move two ostinato notes to a neighboring tuning area for one cycle, then return to the home chord through the unchanged bass notes.

rhythm.simple: A rolling twelve-beat cycle grouped in threes, with the shaker marking the groups.
rhythm.layered: Let the melody lean on the second note of each group while the ostinato keeps all four groups even.
rhythm.intricate: Phrase the melody in groups of four against the four groups of three, so the accents realign only at the end of a full cycle.

motifs: a rising run of three notes that circles back to the first
a repeated high note answered by a descending stepwise phrase
palettes.production: Close, dry acoustic recording with natural string resonance and a soft room; no electronic percussion.

palettes.name: Afrobeat Long Vamp
leads: tenor saxophone phrases over the vamp
muted trumpet lines in call and response
supports: two clean electric guitars playing interlocking parts
a short repeating horn riff in unison
palettes.bass: repeating electric bass ostinato that locks with the kick and leaves space

harmony.simple: Hold a single minor-seventh chord for the whole vamp, with one dominant chord at the turnaround.
harmony.layered: Alternate the minor-seventh chord with its neighbor a fourth above, changing only when the horn riff changes.
harmony.intricate: Stay on the home chord while the horn riff outlines a different chord color above it each time, resolving to the dominant only at the very end of the vamp.

rhythm.simple: A driving four-beat groove with the kick and bass locked together and steady eighth-note hi-hats.
rhythm.layered: Interlock the two guitars so each plays the gaps the other leaves, with congas answering the snare.
rhythm.intricate: Layer a three-against-four accent in the second guitar and let the horn riff land on a different beat each repeat, while the kick and bass never move.

motifs: a two-bar horn riff that ends on a held note
a staccato guitar figure that climbs by step and drops an octave
palettes.production: Live-band warmth, dry and punchy, with the two guitars and the horns separated across the stereo field; a long vamp that grows by adding detail, not by getting louder.

palettes.name: Amapiano Log-Drum Groove
leads: jazzy piano chord riff with light embellishments
supports: warm electric piano chords
soft shaker and rim-click groove
palettes.bass: log-drum bass with pitch glides between chord roots

harmony.simple: Loop two jazzy chords, a minor ninth and a dominant thirteenth, with a gentle turnaround every fourth bar.
harmony.layered: Voice the chords in open fourths and add a suspended fourth on the turnaround, moving the top note by step.
harmony.intricate: Replace one chord of the loop with a chromatic neighbor on the second pass, then restore the original loop while the piano riff keeps its top notes.

rhythm.simple: A steady four-beat pulse with a soft kick, shuffled hi-hats and a light shaker.
rhythm.layered: Let the log-drum bass answer the piano riff in the gaps, with a swung sixteenth-note feel in the hats.
rhythm.intricate: Offset the piano riff by a sixteenth note against the kick on alternate bars, while the shaker keeps the grid steady.

motifs: a four-note piano riff that rises and then falls back to its start
a syncopated bass answer that ends on a pitch glide
palettes.production: Smooth, spacious mix with a round low end and no harsh peaks; light analog warmth; the groove stays relaxed rather than hard-hitting.

palettes.name: Maqam Courtyard Ensemble
leads: ney flute with breathy ornamented lines
supports: qanun rolling accompaniment
riq and darbuka playing a four-beat cycle
palettes.bass: low string bass or cello sustaining the tonic and fifth

harmony.simple: Stay in one mode in the Hijaz style, with its characteristic augmented second, around a steady tonic and fifth.
harmony.layered: Begin in Hijaz and visit a neighboring mode for the middle phrase through a shared pivot note, then return by repeating the opening ornament.
harmony.intricate: Answer the lead with the same phrase restated on a new tonic, hold a pivot note while the mode changes beneath it, and return to the opening mode with the original ornament intact.

rhythm.simple: A four-beat cycle that pairs deep strokes with light, bright strokes.
rhythm.layered: Let the riq decorate the off-beats while the darbuka keeps its low strokes steady.
rhythm.intricate: Vary the cycle's ending with a short fill that lands exactly on the next downbeat, and let the lead anticipate the beat by a sixteenth note.

motifs: a turn around the second degree that resolves down to the tonic
a held note ornamented with a quick upper neighbor
palettes.production: Warm acoustic ensemble in a stone room; fretless ornaments left audible; no piano or other fixed-pitch keyboards.

palettes.name: Makam Aksak Evening
supports: kanun arpeggios and trills
darbuka and frame drum playing the nine-beat cycle
palettes.bass: warm upright bass sustaining the tonic and fifth

harmony.simple: Stay in one Hicaz-flavored mode over a steady tonic drone, with the augmented second as its main color.
harmony.layered: Answer the first phrase a step higher in the same mode, then return to the tonic through a short descending run.
harmony.intricate: Pivot on one shared note into a neighboring mode for the middle phrase, then return to the opening mode with the original ornament.

rhythm.simple: A nine-beat cycle grouped 2+2+2+3, with the long group landing as a lilt at the end.
rhythm.layered: Let the lead phrase across the groups and rest on the final three-beat group while the drums keep all groups even.
rhythm.intricate: Rotate the grouping to 3+2+2+2 for one pass, then return to 2+2+2+3 together on the downbeat.

motifs: a quick turn that lands on the long group's first beat
a repeated two-note figure that stretches into the long group
palettes.production: Lively acoustic ensemble, close and dry, with the hand percussion clearly audible; no electronic drums.

palettes.name: Raga-Inspired Evening
leads: bansuri flute with long breath phrases
supports: tabla playing the ten-beat cycle softly
sarangi with sustained bowed lines
palettes.bass: tanpura drone on the tonic and fifth with a low string sounding the foundation

harmony.simple: Stay in one raga-inspired mode with a raised fourth, over a steady tonic and fifth drone.
harmony.layered: Introduce the scale slowly: tonic area first, then the raised fourth, then the upper octave, returning to the tonic after each.
harmony.intricate: Weave short phrases that touch the scale's notes in a winding order, pausing on the raised fourth before resolving to the tonic.

rhythm.simple: A ten-beat cycle grouped 2+3+2+3, played softly with a clear first beat.
rhythm.layered: Let the lead begin phrases just before the first beat and land with the tabla on it, while the tabla fills only the last group.
rhythm.intricate: Compress one phrase into half the cycle, then spread the next over a cycle and a half, resolving together on the first beat.

motifs: a slow upward slide to the raised fourth and back
a three-note phrase repeated three times, each ending on a higher note
palettes.production: Close, natural acoustic recording; clear string resonance and a soft tabla; no reverb wash, and no piano or other fixed-pitch keyboards.

palettes.name: South Indian Classical-Inspired Trio
moods: joyful interplay between melody and rhythm
leads: bamboo flute with clean, rounded phrases
supports: mridangam answering in the gaps
ghatam adding crisp accents
palettes.bass: tambura drone on the tonic and fifth

harmony.simple: Stay inside a five-note major-pentatonic mode over a steady drone.
harmony.layered: Move the phrase's resting note from the tonic to the fifth and back, ornamenting each return.
harmony.intricate: Sequence a short phrase through each degree of the scale in turn, ending every sequence on a longer note that realigns with the first beat.

rhythm.simple: An eight-beat cycle grouped 4+2+2 with clear, even strokes.
rhythm.layered: Let the mridangam answer the lead's phrases in the gaps, never during the held notes.
rhythm.intricate: Set a three-note grouping across the eight-beat cycle so the pattern drifts, then lands on the first beat after the third repetition.

motifs: a rising five-note scale run that falls back by step
a short phrase repeated with a different ornament each time
palettes.production: Clean, close acoustic recording with a bright, dry room; the percussion sits just behind the melody; no keyboards.

palettes.name: Garden Koto and Shakuhachi
moods: quiet attention to the silence between notes
leads: shamisen melody with crisp, bright plucked notes
supports: koto arpeggios in a five-note tuning
a soft taiko drum used sparingly
palettes.bass: a 17-string bass koto marking the home note and its fifth

harmony.simple: Stay inside a hirajoshi-flavored five-note scale around one home note.
harmony.layered: Shift the home note to a neighboring scale tone for the middle phrase, then return to the first home note.
harmony.intricate: Answer each phrase with its inversion inside the scale, so the ear hears the same shape reflected, and finish by returning to the home note.

rhythm.simple: A slow, spacious pulse with silence between phrases; no steady drum groove.
rhythm.layered: Let the plucked notes mark an unhurried four-beat pulse while the flute floats freely across it.
rhythm.intricate: Stretch one phrase over six beats and its answer over four, then settle back into the four-beat pulse together.

motifs: a single long note that falls a half step and then rests
a two-note pluck answered by a slow upward slide
palettes.production: Quiet room recording with natural breath and string noise; plenty of silence; no synthesizer pads or piano.

palettes.name: Guzheng and Erhu River
leads: erhu with sliding, voice-like bowed phrases
dizi bamboo flute with a clear, bright tone
supports: guzheng glissandi and arpeggios
pipa tremolo and light plucked accents
palettes.bass: soft cello holding long roots under the melody

harmony.simple: Keep a major-pentatonic melody over long, open fifths.
harmony.layered: Move the melody into its relative minor pentatonic for the middle phrase, then return to the major color.
harmony.intricate: Answer the first phrase a fourth higher in the same pentatonic set, then bring both phrases together over a held open fifth.

rhythm.simple: An unhurried steady pulse with gentle plucked accents.
rhythm.layered: Open in free time with the flute alone, then settle into an even four-beat pulse as the plucked strings enter.
rhythm.intricate: Let the guzheng and pipa share a repeating figure that shifts by one beat each pass, resolving together at the cadence.

motifs: a rising slide that settles on a long, ornamented note
a plucked figure of three notes that repeats and drifts upward
palettes.production: Intimate close-miked acoustic recording; natural bow noise and string slides audible; no synthesized strings.

palettes.name: Gamelan-Inspired Shimmer
moods: a slow shimmer of metal and breath
leads: gender metallophone with shimmering paired-mallet patterns
suling bamboo flute floating above the cycle
supports: bonang pot-gongs interlocking in two parts
kendang drum guiding the cycle
palettes.bass: a low slentem metallophone and a large hanging gong marking the end of each cycle

harmony.simple: Keep a single five-tone slendro-like tuning, with the core melody sounding on every beat.
harmony.layered: Let the elaborating parts move in stepwise patterns one octave higher while the core melody stays unchanged.
harmony.intricate: Shift the emphasis to a different tone of the same five-tone tuning for the middle cycle, then return to the home tone as the large gong sounds.

rhythm.simple: Four-beat phrases in a long cycle, with the large gong sounding at the end of every sixteen beats.
rhythm.layered: Interlock two bonang parts so that together they sound a continuous pattern that neither plays alone.
rhythm.intricate: Double the elaborating pattern's speed in the middle cycle, then halve it again, keeping the gong cycle's length unchanged.

motifs: a four-note core melody that falls by step and rests on its last tone
a fast pair of notes that repeats and shifts one tone each cycle
palettes.production: Close acoustic recording of tuned metal with a long natural ring; keep the gentle beating between paired instruments; no piano or other equal-tempered instruments.

palettes.name: Sunset City Pop
moods: bright nostalgia with a spring in its step
supports: clean funky guitar chops
soft synthesized brass punctuation
palettes.bass: round electric bass with light slapped accents

harmony.simple: Loop four bright major-seventh and minor-seventh chords, resolving on a warm major-sixth chord.
harmony.layered: Add a secondary dominant before the loop restarts and a ninth on the final chord.
harmony.intricate: Lift the whole loop up a whole step for the final pass through a short pivot chord, keeping the melody's top notes the same.

rhythm.simple: A bouncy four-beat groove with a crisp snare on two and four and sixteenth-note hi-hats.
rhythm.layered: Let the guitar chops answer the bass in the gaps while the electric piano holds the melody's long notes.
rhythm.intricate: Syncopate the synthesized brass a sixteenth note ahead of beat three while the drums and bass hold the grid.

motifs: a bright three-note pickup that leaps up a sixth
a descending sequence of chord tones repeated a step lower
palettes.production: Polished, slightly glossy mix with a tight low end and warm analog character; keep the dynamics gentle rather than loud.

palettes.name: Celtic Session Reels
leads: wooden flute with rolls and cuts
supports: bodhran keeping a steady pulse with tipper accents
bouzouki chords and countermelody
palettes.bass: a low-tuned guitar playing open bass notes

harmony.simple: Stay in one mode with a major tonic and the chord a whole step below it.
harmony.layered: Alternate the tonic chord with the lowered-seventh chord, and let a minor-fifth chord color the second part.
harmony.intricate: Change the mode between the first and second parts while keeping the tune's top notes recognizable, then return to the first mode for the last repeat.

rhythm.simple: A steady reel pulse with two big beats in each bar, even eighth notes and a light off-beat lift.
rhythm.layered: Group the eighth notes in a repeated 3+3+2 accent for one part, then return to even pairs.
rhythm.intricate: Shift the accent a beat later on the repeat of a phrase, so the tune seems to chase itself, then realign at the final cadence.

motifs: a quick run that climbs a scale and drops back to the starting note
a three-note roll on a long note, repeated an octave higher
palettes.production: Live-room warmth, dry and bright; fiddle and flute sit slightly forward of the guitar and bodhran; no drum kit.

palettes.name: Slip Jig Parlour
supports: upright piano with rolling left-hand chords
bodhran played softly with a soft tipper
palettes.bass: upright bass marking the first beat of each group of three

harmony.simple: Alternate a major tonic chord with its dominant, with a relative-minor chord at the end of the second phrase.
harmony.layered: Move through a descending bass line under the second phrase and resolve on a warm added-sixth chord.
harmony.intricate: Visit the relative minor for the second strain through a pivot chord, then return with the melody's opening notes reharmonized.

rhythm.simple: A flowing nine-beat lilt in three groups of three, with the first beat of each group lightly stressed.
rhythm.layered: Let the melody linger on the last note of the third group while the accompaniment keeps all three groups even.
rhythm.intricate: Anticipate the second group with a tied note, then rejoin the full groups of three at the cadence.

motifs: a rocking three-note figure that circles up and down
a long note that slips down by step into the next group
palettes.production: Intimate parlour acoustics with a natural room; the piano stays soft and rounded; no amplified instruments.

palettes.name: Nordic Polska Fiddle
supports: accordion chord answers
acoustic guitar with a simple open-chord pulse
palettes.bass: upright bass on the first beat with a soft drone fifth

harmony.simple: Hold a drone fifth under a minor mode, changing chords only every two bars.
harmony.layered: Lift the second part to the relative major for its first half, then fall back to the minor mode with a small drop in the bass.
harmony.intricate: Let a drone on the fifth continue while the melody visits a Dorian color, resolving back through the minor tonic.

rhythm.simple: A lilting three-beat dance with the second beat leaning slightly long.
rhythm.layered: Let the accompaniment settle on the first beat while the melody bows across the second and third in uneven steps.
rhythm.intricate: Alternate bars that lean on beat two with bars that lean on beat three, keeping the first beat firm in the bass.

motifs: a long note that tips down to a short pair of notes
a leaping fifth answered by a rolling stepwise turn
palettes.production: Wooden-room acoustics with audible bow noise and ringing sympathetic strings; no electronic effects.

palettes.name: Flamenco Compas Guitar
leads: nylon-string flamenco guitar falsetas with rasgueado accents
a warm flute answering the guitar
supports: palmas handclaps marking the twelve-beat cycle
cajon with deep and sharp strokes
palettes.bass: upright bass or low guitar notes outlining the strong beats

harmony.simple: Repeat a Phrygian descent such as A minor, G, F and E, settling on the E major chord.
harmony.layered: Let a major third color the E chord as a bright Phrygian dominant, then return quietly to the minor home.
harmony.intricate: Pause on the dominant before a final descent, and reharmonize one pass with a chromatic neighbor chord on the way down.

rhythm.simple: Accent counts twelve, three, six, eight and ten of a twelve-beat cycle, the 3+3+2+2+2 grouping carried by the handclaps.
rhythm.layered: Let the guitar's rasgueado land on the accented counts while the cajon fills the unaccented ones.
rhythm.intricate: Displace one falseta by a single count for a cycle, then realign on the accented count twelve.

motifs: a falling Phrygian run that ends on a sharp accent
a rapid repeated note that opens into a sliding scale
palettes.production: Intimate nylon-string guitar recording with audible fingernail attack and handclaps close to the microphone; no drum kit.

palettes.name: Klezmer Freylekh Dance
moods: joyful wedding-dance abandon with a tear in it
leads: clarinet with sobbing ornaments and fast runs
violin with bowed slides and quick turns
supports: accordion chord answers
frame drum playing a steady pulse
palettes.bass: tuba or upright bass playing oom-pah roots and fifths

harmony.simple: Alternate a minor tonic with a major dominant in the freygish mode, whose second degree is lowered.
harmony.layered: Slide from the freygish mode into its relative major for the second strain, then return to the minor home.
harmony.intricate: Modulate in the middle strain to the related major with a pivot note, and end with a sudden return to the minor home.

rhythm.simple: A bouncing two-beat oom-pah pulse with a strong off-beat accent.
rhythm.layered: Add a quick triplet turn at the end of each phrase while the oom-pah pulse stays steady.
rhythm.intricate: Let the lead stretch one phrase rubato over a sustained chord, then snap back together with the dance pulse on the downbeat.

motifs: a sobbing slide into a long note followed by a quick turn
a repeated stepwise phrase that climbs a scale and tumbles down
palettes.production: Lively live-room acoustics with close clarinet and violin, dry and warm; no electric instruments.

palettes.name: Kopanitsa Village Dance
leads: gaida bagpipe melody over its drone
supports: accordion chord answers
tapan drum marking the long group
palettes.bass: upright bass playing roots and drones, outlining the grouping

harmony.simple: Hold a drone tonic and move between two chords a step apart.
harmony.layered: Add a flattened second as a passing color before returning to the drone tonic.
harmony.intricate: Answer the melody a step lower on the second pass, keep the drone unchanged, and cadence on the open fifth.

rhythm.simple: An eleven-beat cycle grouped 2+2+3+2+2, with the long group sounding like a lift.
rhythm.layered: Accent the long group firmly and keep the short groups light so the dancers feel the lift.
rhythm.intricate: Rotate the long group to the end for one cycle, 2+2+2+2+3, then restore the original grouping together.

motifs: a quick turn that lands on the long group's first beat
a leaping fourth answered by a stepwise run
palettes.production: Open-air acoustic feel, dry and bright, with the drum and bagpipe forward; no electronic instruments.

palettes.name: Musette Waltz Cafe
leads: accordion with a gentle vibrato shimmer
supports: acoustic guitar strumming the waltz pattern
violin pizzicato countermelody
palettes.bass: upright bass on the first beat with soft walking motion on beats two and three

harmony.simple: Alternate a major tonic with its dominant, visiting the relative minor in the middle phrase.
harmony.layered: Add a circle-of-fifths sequence into the bridge and a chromatic passing chord before the final cadence.
harmony.intricate: Pivot to the relative minor with a diminished chord, and return to the major theme with the accordion melody reharmonized in thirds.

rhythm.simple: A graceful three-beat waltz with a firm first beat and light second and third beats.
rhythm.layered: Let the guitar play the waltz pattern steadily while the accordion's melody leans slightly behind the beat.
rhythm.intricate: Suggest a two-against-three cross-rhythm in the accompaniment for a bar, then reunite the accents at the phrase end.

motifs: a leaping sixth that settles by step
a fast upper-neighbor turn repeated on a longer note
palettes.production: Warm cafe-room acoustics; the accordion and clarinet sit forward; no electronic effects.

palettes.name: Baroque Trio Sonata
moods: elegant forward motion with a dancing step
leads: baroque flute with clear, rounded phrases
supports: second violin in imitation
harpsichord realizing the continuo chords
palettes.bass: cello with a walking continuo bass line

harmony.simple: Move through a circle-of-fifths sequence from the tonic back to the tonic.
harmony.layered: Include suspensions that resolve downward by step in the inner voices at each cadence.
harmony.intricate: Modulate to the dominant and then the relative minor with a pivot chord, returning through a descending-fifths sequence to a final authentic cadence.

rhythm.simple: A steady four-beat pulse with continuous eighth-note motion in the bass.
rhythm.layered: Pass a dotted figure between the two upper parts, never both at once.
rhythm.intricate: Stagger the entries of a short subject by one bar in each voice, as in a fugue exposition, with the bass entering last.

motifs: a rising scale fragment answered by a falling sequence
a repeated note that leaps up a fourth and walks down
palettes.production: Dry, close chamber acoustics with a gut-string character and no excess vibrato; no electric or electronic instruments.

palettes.name: Old-Time Clawhammer Porch
supports: flat-top guitar playing boom-chuck strums
mountain dulcimer drone
palettes.bass: upright bass walking roots and fifths in two

harmony.simple: Stay in one mode with a drone fifth, changing chords only at the ends of phrases.
harmony.layered: Alternate the tonic chord with the chord a whole step below it, and add a relative-minor chord for the second part.
harmony.intricate: Move the second part to a neighboring mode by changing only one note of the scale, then return to the first mode for the last repeat.

rhythm.simple: A steady two-beat bounce with the banjo's down-pick pattern on the beat.
rhythm.layered: Let the fiddle's bowing lean on the off-beats while the banjo and guitar keep the bounce.
rhythm.intricate: Shift the banjo's accent by an eighth note on the repeat of a phrase, then realign it with the fiddle at the cadence.

motifs: a bouncing figure that drops a fourth and climbs back
a repeated open-string note answered by a quick scale run
palettes.production: Front-porch acoustics, close and dry, with string noise audible; no electric instruments.

palettes.name: Porch Blues Slide
moods: slow evening porch with a kindly ache
leads: bottleneck slide guitar with long gliding notes
supports: steady foot stomp on beats one and three
a second guitar fingerpicking a thumb-bass pattern
palettes.bass: upright bass walking the changes in a relaxed shuffle

harmony.simple: A twelve-bar blues in one key, using only the one, four and five chords.
harmony.layered: Add a quick change to the four chord in the second bar and a turnaround at the end.
harmony.intricate: Replace the turnaround with a descending chromatic line and let the last chorus pause on the five chord before resolving.

rhythm.simple: A slow shuffle felt in twelve pulses grouped in threes, with the foot stomp on the first and third groups.
rhythm.layered: Let the slide phrases answer the thumb-bass pattern in the gaps.
rhythm.intricate: Delay a lick by one pulse each chorus, so the phrase lands on a different part of the group.

motifs: a slide up to a held note followed by a short falling answer
a two-note call repeated once and answered by a bend
palettes.production: Raw but warm acoustic recording, with slide noise, breath and foot stomp audible; no drum kit and no heavy distortion.

palettes.name: Ragtime Parlour
supports: clarinet obbligato in the gaps
soft snare brushes and a wood block
palettes.bass: piano left-hand oom-pah bass alternating low roots and mid-register chords

harmony.simple: Move from the tonic to the dominant in the first strain and to the subdominant in the trio.
harmony.layered: Add secondary dominants and a chromatic bass walk-up into each strain change.
harmony.intricate: Use a diminished passing chord to pivot into the trio, and bring the first strain back with a re-voiced final chord.

rhythm.simple: A steady two-beat oom-pah in the left hand with a syncopated right-hand melody.
rhythm.layered: Place syncopated accents between the beats while the left hand stays perfectly even.
rhythm.intricate: Layer a three-note pattern in the right hand over the even two-beat pulse, resolving back to ordinary syncopation at the end of each strain.

motifs: a syncopated leap that lands off the beat and steps down
a repeated chord tone that climbs a scale in sixths
palettes.production: Close upright-piano acoustics with a slightly bright room; the left hand stays even and light; no electric instruments.

palettes.name: Second-Line Brass Parade
supports: clarinet obbligato runs
snare and bass drum parade groove
palettes.bass: sousaphone playing bouncing roots and fifths

harmony.simple: Alternate the tonic and dominant chords in a joyful, singable tune.
harmony.layered: Add a quick sixth chord and diminished passing chords at the ends of phrases.
harmony.intricate: Move to the subdominant key for a contrasting strain, and return with a held dominant tag before the final repeat.

rhythm.simple: A syncopated parade groove with the bass drum on the downbeats and the snare rolling in the gaps.
rhythm.layered: Place a rolling snare accent just before beat two so the whole band leans into it.
rhythm.intricate: Shift the accent a sixteenth note earlier for one repeated phrase, then settle the band back onto the backbeat together.

motifs: a bright call on a repeated note answered by a falling slide
a stepwise climb that ends with a playful held note
palettes.production: Open-air acoustic brass and drums with natural room bounce, bright but never harsh; no electric instruments.

palettes.name: Steel Guitar Waltz
moods: slow dance in a quiet hall
leads: pedal steel with long gliding bends
supports: acoustic guitar playing a bass-strum waltz pattern
soft brushes on the snare
palettes.bass: upright bass on the first beat with a walk-up on cadences

harmony.simple: Use the tonic, subdominant and dominant chords in a classic waltz progression.
harmony.layered: Add a relative-minor chord and a descending bass line before the turnaround.
harmony.intricate: Use a secondary dominant and a brief move to the relative minor for the bridge, and return with a warm added-sixth ending.

rhythm.simple: A gentle three-beat waltz with a soft first beat and light brushes on the other two.
rhythm.layered: Let the steel guitar's bends float over the beat while the brushes stay even.
rhythm.intricate: Stretch one phrase across a bar line with a held note, then land on the first beat with the whole band together.

motifs: a long gliding bend that resolves up a step
a falling three-note figure answered by a held note
palettes.production: Warm, spacious studio sound with a soft room; the steel guitar shimmers gently and the drums stay quiet.

palettes.name: Acoustic String Swing
leads: lead guitar with fast arpeggios and chromatic runs
supports: two rhythm guitars playing a driving four-to-the-bar pump
clarinet answering in the gaps
palettes.bass: upright bass walking quarter notes

harmony.simple: Use a sixth-chord tonic and a quick ii-V back to the home chord in a major key.
harmony.layered: Insert a minor-key bridge and diminished passing chords between phrases.
harmony.intricate: Reharmonize the last eight bars with tritone substitutions and a chromatic pedal, returning to the theme's sixth chord.

rhythm.simple: A driving four-beat pump on the rhythm guitars with a light swing.
rhythm.layered: Let the lead anticipate beat one by an eighth note while the pump stays steady.
rhythm.intricate: Stack a two-bar triplet phrase over the pump and rejoin on the downbeat.

motifs: a fast chromatic run that lands on a held sixth
a repeated arpeggio that climbs a step each time
palettes.production: Dry, close acoustic strings in a small cafe room; no drum kit, since the pump supplies the rhythm; natural dynamics.

palettes.name: Hard Bop Front Line
leads: trumpet and tenor saxophone playing the theme in unison
tenor saxophone solo with bluesy bends
supports: piano comping with punchy chords
drums with a propulsive ride cymbal and snare accents
palettes.bass: upright bass walking quarter notes

harmony.simple: A blues-based minor theme with a bright major turnaround.
harmony.layered: Use minor ii-V progressions leading to a surprising major chord in the bridge.
harmony.intricate: Substitute tritone chords in the turnaround and move the bridge up a minor third before returning to the theme.

rhythm.simple: A swinging four-beat groove with a steady ride cymbal.
rhythm.layered: Let the piano's chord stabs answer the horns' phrases on the off-beats.
rhythm.intricate: Superimpose a three-beat phrase over the four-beat bar for two choruses, then reunite the accents at the bridge.

motifs: a bluesy minor-third bend that leaps up a fourth
a repeated riff that climbs by half steps
palettes.production: Live small-group room sound with natural cymbal brightness and controlled horn peaks; no electronic instruments.

palettes.name: Andean Huayno Highlands
leads: quena flute with breathy, airy phrases
zampona panpipes played in interlocking pairs
supports: charango strumming in a bright pattern
bombo drum marking the pulse
palettes.bass: soft guitar bass notes or low panpipe tones outlining the root and fifth

harmony.simple: Alternate a minor-pentatonic tonic with its relative major in a simple two-chord pattern.
harmony.layered: Answer each phrase a minor third higher, in the relative major, before returning to the minor home.
harmony.intricate: Linger on the relative major's dominant before a final fall to the minor home, with the melody's last notes echoed an octave lower.

rhythm.simple: A galloping two-beat pattern of one long note followed by two short notes.
rhythm.layered: Let the panpipes alternate their phrases between the two players while the charango keeps the gallop.
rhythm.intricate: Syncopate the bombo against the charango for one phrase, then bring them together on the cadence.

motifs: a falling minor third answered by a rising pentatonic run
a long-short-short figure repeated on a higher step
palettes.production: Open, airy acoustic recording with natural breath on the pipes and a bright charango; no electronic instruments.

palettes.name: Slow Cumbia Accordion
leads: gaita flute with a breathy, hopping line
supports: guacharaca scraper keeping the rhythm
alegre and llamador drums in conversation
palettes.bass: upright bass playing a swinging root-and-fifth pattern

harmony.simple: Alternate a minor tonic with its dominant, resolving to the major tonic at the very end.
harmony.layered: Add the relative major as a brief, brighter color in the middle phrase.
harmony.intricate: Answer the accordion's phrase with the flute a fourth higher, and pivot to the relative major for one repeat before returning to the minor home.

rhythm.simple: A steady four-beat sway, with the scraper marking the off-beats and the drums on the downbeats.
rhythm.layered: Let the alegre drum answer the accordion's phrases in the gaps, while the llamador keeps the pulse.
rhythm.intricate: Shift the alegre drum's answers one beat later on the repeat of a phrase, then realign on the cadence.

motifs: a short hopping figure that leaps up a third and steps down
a repeated high note that falls into a slow turn
palettes.production: Warm plaza acoustics with hand drums close and dry and a rounded accordion; no drum kit.

palettes.name: Jarocho Sesquialtera
leads: requinto jarocho with quick melodic runs
arpa jarocha melody with rolling bass strings
supports: jarana strumming a patterned rhythm
tarima footwork as percussion
palettes.bass: the harp's low strings alternating tonic and dominant

harmony.simple: Alternate the tonic and dominant chords in a bright major key.
harmony.layered: Add the subdominant as a brief change of color before the dominant returns.
harmony.intricate: Pivot to the relative minor for one phrase, then return to the major with the melody's top notes unchanged.

rhythm.simple: A six-beat cycle that the strumming alternates between two groups of three and three groups of two, the classic 6/8 against 3/4 lilt.
rhythm.layered: Let the harp keep the groups of three while the jarana leans into groups of two.
rhythm.intricate: Let the footwork follow the 3/4 feel while the harp stays in 6/8, and realign both on the cadence.

motifs: a bright repeating figure that shifts between two accents
a quick run that ends on a held note in the second group
palettes.production: Natural festive acoustics with percussive footwork close to the microphone and strummed strings forward; no electronic instruments.

palettes.name: Choro Roda Afternoon
supports: cavaquinho playing bright rhythmic chords
pandeiro with a rolling pattern
palettes.bass: seven-string guitar playing counter-melodic bass runs

harmony.simple: Move through the tonic, dominant and relative minor in a clear, singable theme.
harmony.layered: Add secondary dominants leading into each new section and a modulation to the subdominant for the contrasting strain.
harmony.intricate: Chain secondary dominants through a descending circle of fifths and return to the opening key with a chromatic bass line.

rhythm.simple: A lively two-beat pulse with the pandeiro's steady sixteenth-note pattern.
rhythm.layered: Let the guitar's bass runs answer the flute's phrases between the beats.
rhythm.intricate: Syncopate the theme against the pandeiro for one phrase, then lock in with the pulse at the cadence.

motifs: a quick turn that dips to a lower neighbor and leaps up a sixth
a chain of descending sixteenth notes ending on a held tone
palettes.production: Warm backyard acoustics with each instrument clearly audible; no electronic instruments.

palettes.name: Steelpan Calypso
leads: tenor steelpan melody with rolled notes
supports: rhythm guitar playing sunny upstrokes
shaker and light congas
palettes.bass: bass pan or electric bass playing bouncing syncopated roots

harmony.simple: Move through bright major chords in a one-four-five pattern with a swinging turnaround.
harmony.layered: Add the relative minor in the middle phrase and a quick secondary dominant before the last chorus.
harmony.intricate: Lift the last chorus by a whole step through a pivot chord, keeping the steelpan melody's contour unchanged.

rhythm.simple: A bouncing four-beat groove with a syncopated bass and a steady shaker.
rhythm.layered: Let the rolled steelpan notes fill the gaps between the guitar upstrokes.
rhythm.intricate: Place the melody's accents a sixteenth note ahead of the beat for two phrases, then settle back onto the beat with the bass.

motifs: a bright upward skip followed by a rolled descending line
a repeated two-note call answered by a longer melodic phrase
palettes.production: Bright, open-air production with ringing pan tones and a warm low end; keep the level friendly rather than loud.

palettes.name: Charanga Danzon Salon
moods: courtly dance with a gentle sway
leads: violin section with sweet sustained lines
supports: piano with arpeggiated chords
timbales and guiro keeping a courtly pulse
palettes.bass: upright bass walking quietly with anticipated roots

harmony.simple: Alternate a major tonic and dominant in a graceful, songlike theme.
harmony.layered: Add a relative-minor chord in the second section and a bright subdominant before the final return.
harmony.intricate: Modulate to the subdominant for the contrasting section and return to the opening key through a held dominant.

rhythm.simple: A courtly two-beat pulse with a five-note figure on the percussion.
rhythm.layered: Let the piano's arpeggios fill the gaps while the percussion repeats the five-note figure.
rhythm.intricate: Superimpose a gentle syncopation in the violin line over the steady two-beat pulse, realigning at the cadence.

motifs: a graceful turn that rises a step and then falls a third
a held note followed by a quick five-note descending pattern
palettes.production: Intimate salon acoustics with soft strings and flute, delicate percussion and a natural room; no electric instruments.

palettes.name: Lo-Fi Study Loops
supports: dusty drum machine pattern with swung hats
soft vinyl crackle and tape hiss
palettes.bass: warm, rounded sub-bass following the chord roots

harmony.simple: Loop a four-chord progression of minor-seventh and major-seventh chords.
harmony.layered: Add a chromatic approach chord before the loop restarts and vary the melody's top note each pass.
harmony.intricate: Swap the loop's third chord for a borrowed chord every second pass, while the melody keeps its original top notes.

rhythm.simple: A slow, slightly late kick-and-snare pattern with swung hats.
rhythm.layered: Hold the snare a touch behind the beat while the hats stay soft and the bass leaves space.
rhythm.intricate: Stagger a two-bar melody against the four-bar loop so phrases land in different places each pass.

motifs: a lazy three-note phrase that falls and rests
a repeated chord-top note that changes its last step each pass
palettes.production: Warm tape saturation, softly rolled-off highs and quiet vinyl noise; leave plenty of space; no loud peaks.

palettes.name: Motorik Highway
supports: a second synthesizer playing a steady sequence in eighth notes
tight hi-hat and snare locked to the kick
palettes.bass: unbroken eighth-note electric bass, changing roots only every two bars

harmony.simple: Alternate two chords, tonic and subdominant, every two bars.
harmony.layered: Add a relative-minor chord at the end of each eight-bar block.
harmony.intricate: Lift the melody a fourth higher every sixteen bars while the bass holds its pattern, then drop back for the last block.

rhythm.simple: An unbroken four-beat motorik beat: the kick on the downbeats, the snare on two and four, and hi-hats in steady eighth notes.
rhythm.layered: Add a repeating sixteenth-note guitar figure over the beat while the snare stays steady.
rhythm.intricate: Let the sequence drift by an eighth note against the beat for four bars, then snap back to the grid together.

motifs: a repeating two-note guitar figure that rises a step each block
a long synthesizer note held across four bars
palettes.production: Dry, tight drums, crisp but not loud; a clean, wide guitar and a warm analog sequence; no heavy distortion.

palettes.name: Dream-Pop Haze
leads: chorused guitar melody swimming in reverb
supports: slowly strummed open guitar chords in a long reverb wash
brushed drums with a soft snare
palettes.bass: round bass guitar sliding between roots

harmony.simple: Move between a major-seventh chord and an added-ninth chord a fourth away.
harmony.layered: Add a suspended fourth on the turnaround and let the top note drift by step across the chord changes.
harmony.intricate: Borrow one chord from the parallel minor for the second pass, then resolve back to the major-seventh chord with a held suspension.

rhythm.simple: A slow, floating four-beat pulse with a soft snare on two and four.
rhythm.layered: Let the strumming lag very slightly behind the drums while the bass stays on the beat.
rhythm.intricate: Overlap two guitar delays at different lengths so the echoes drift in and out of alignment, without moving the drums.

motifs: a slow upward slide into a held note
a two-note sigh repeated and echoed an octave higher
palettes.production: Soft, hazy mix with wide reverb and gentle chorus; the dynamics stay low and the sound blooms rather than roars; no heavy distortion.

palettes.name: Two-Step Garage
supports: shuffled hi-hats and ghost-note snares
warm pad chords
palettes.bass: warm sub-bass with rolling slides

harmony.simple: Loop two lush chords, a minor ninth and a major seventh, with a short rising turnaround.
harmony.layered: Add a chromatic neighbor chord before the loop restarts and move the pad voicing by step.
harmony.intricate: Change the loop's second chord to a borrowed chord on alternate passes while the chopped melody keeps its top notes.

rhythm.simple: A skipping two-step pattern with the kick on the first beat and a syncopated second kick, a snare on two and four, and shuffled hats.
rhythm.layered: Hold the snare steady on two and four while ghost notes skip around it and the bass slides between them.
rhythm.intricate: Shift the chopped chords a sixteenth note behind the beat for four bars, then land on the downbeat together.

motifs: a skipping three-note chord stab that rises a step
a held pad note that slides up a half step into the next bar
palettes.production: Polished, spacious club mix with a deep, controlled low end and crisp hats; no distorted bass or abrasive peaks.

palettes.name: Chiptune Quest
leads: second pulse-wave lead in a lighter tone
supports: quick arpeggios that imply full chords on one channel
noise-channel percussion
palettes.bass: triangle-wave bass playing octave jumps

harmony.simple: Stay in a bright major key, with arpeggios outlining the tonic, subdominant and dominant chords.
harmony.layered: Add a relative-minor section and let the arpeggios switch speed to show the change.
harmony.intricate: Modulate up a whole step for the last section, and let the two leads trade the melody and a harmony line.

rhythm.simple: A steady four-beat pulse with noise-channel kicks on the downbeats and snares on two and four.
rhythm.layered: Let the arpeggios run in sixteenth notes while the bass jumps in eighth notes.
rhythm.intricate: Alternate two-bar phrases in a hopping rhythm with two-bar phrases in straight eighth notes, never using more than four voices at once.

motifs: a rising arpeggio that ends on a held note with vibrato
a hopping two-note figure that jumps up an octave
palettes.production: Strictly four voices at a time, clean square and triangle tones, hard-edged and unprocessed; no reverb, and no sampled or acoustic instruments.

palettes.name: Celesta Lullaby
leads: celesta melody in a high register
music-box melody with a clear, bell-like tone
supports: harp arpeggios in a gentle rocking pattern
soft sustained strings
palettes.bass: cello playing slow, warm single notes

harmony.simple: Stay in a gentle major key with only the tonic, subdominant and dominant chords.
harmony.layered: Add a relative-minor chord and a suspended fourth before each cadence.
harmony.intricate: Borrow one chord from the parallel minor for the second phrase, then resolve back to the major with a held suspension.

rhythm.simple: A soft six-beat rocking motion in two groups of three.
rhythm.layered: Let the harp rock steadily while the melody floats across the groups with longer notes.
rhythm.intricate: Slip the melody a beat behind the rocking for one phrase, then settle together on the first beat of the next.

motifs: a falling three-note sigh that rests on the last note
a gentle rising sixth that settles by step
palettes.production: Very soft, close acoustic recording with a long, warm tail; the dynamics stay low and calm; no percussion.

palettes.name: Phasing Mallets
leads: marimba pattern in a high register
vibraphone pattern with a soft motor
supports: a second marimba pattern that gradually phases
bass clarinet and clarinet sustaining pulsing chords
palettes.bass: low marimba notes and bass clarinet outlining the roots

harmony.simple: Repeat one pattern of four chords, changing a single note each time around.
harmony.layered: Let the chord pattern change one note per cycle while the high pattern stays unchanged, so the harmony shifts slowly.
harmony.intricate: Build the pattern one note at a time, then remove one note at a time, so the same chords are heard in a new order on the way back.

rhythm.simple: A twelve-beat cycle grouped in threes, with every part playing the same pattern in unison.
rhythm.layered: Let the second part drift ahead by one beat at a time, creating new accent patterns, then return to unison.
rhythm.intricate: Phase the second part by one beat every four cycles until it is three beats ahead, then phase it back to unison.

motifs: a bright repeated figure of five notes that shifts its accents when phased
a rising scale fragment that stops on the same note each cycle
palettes.production: Clean, close acoustic recording with clear mallet attack; the two parts are panned left and right; no electronic instruments.
